topic: Navigating Dynamic Careers in Catalysis and Reaction Engineering
title: Navigating Dynamic Careers in Catalysis and Reaction Engineering
session_title: Navigating Dynamic Careers in Catalysis & Reaction Engineering
abstract: Panelists will discuss their careers in the fields of catalysis and/or reaction engineering; how the Catalysis and Reaction Engineering Division of AICHE has played a role in their careers; and advice on how to navigate a dynamic and fulfilling career in the field.
